vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Clean consultation data and produce transparent descriptive summaries with appropriate denominators.
requirements.zh: 清理咨询数据，并采用适当分母形成透明的描述性摘要。

requirements.en: Use R or equivalent analysis tools and communicate findings to a multidisciplinary team.
requirements.zh: 使用 R 或同类分析工具，并向跨专业团队沟通发现。

requirements.en: Bring relevant urban studies training and distinguish research support from policy approval.
requirements.zh: 具备相关城市研究培训，并区分研究支持与政策审批。

requirements.en: Preferred: independently prepare and sign statutory planning submissions.
requirements.zh: 优先：独立编制并签署法定规划申报文件。
